lines.en: My limbs are too long to gather.

lines.zh: 我身上多了几条黑色的肢。
lines.en: Extra black limbs hang from me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方空气发紫。
lines.en: The air goes purple where I pass.

lines.zh: 我顺着林线挪，不踏进空地。
lines.en: I creep along the treeline without stepping into the open.

lines.zh: 紫色粒子从我身上掉下来。

lines.en: I don't look at people anymore.

lines.zh: 我的手指比我记得的长。
lines.en: My fingers are longer than I remember.

lines.zh: 走到一半我停住，换了个朝向。
lines.en: Halfway there I halt and face a different way.

lines.zh: 我站着，身体在轻微抽动。

lines.en: I hear something very far off.
My eyes no longer hold shape.

lines.zh: 一只手举起来，关节一节节响。
lines.en: One hand rises, its joints clicking one by one.
There's a black ring on the ground.
I'm trying to stand up straight.
My bones are longer than my hide.
The wind scatters the purple smoke.
I turn, and so do you.
What you see is a shadow.
I lift a hand; you stepped back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里有紫色的东西。
lines.en: There's something violet in my eyes.
I can't count how many shadows you cast.

lines.zh: 一根长指头抬起来，对着你。
lines.en: One long finger lifts and points straight at you.

lines.zh: 你的名字我还读得出来。
lines.en: I can still read your name.

lines.zh: 我一脚一脚靠近，地没响。
lines.en: I come closer foot by foot, and the ground stays silent.

lines.zh: 我身上的紫色闪了一下。

lines.en: I step back; a joint catches.

lines.zh: 几片暗紫的东西落在地上。
lines.en: A few dark violet flecks fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下让我身上少了些东西。
lines.en: That blow leaves me with less of myself.
I'll come over all the same.
I reach out; my arm is long.
It got lighter in my hand.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我的身体只是让了让。
lines.en: You crash into me, and my body merely yields a little.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的手臂。
lines.en: Your hand passed through my arm.

lines.zh: 我身上掉了些紫色的东西。
我把脚抬起来，往旁边落。
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it down to one side.

lines.zh: 我靠近时，你身边的空气凉了。
lines.en: As I close in, the air around you turns cold.
There are no other Endermen here.
I remember them calling in the rain.
I try to raise a hand; it's slow.

lines.zh: 喉咙里漏出一点声音，很短。
lines.en: A little sound leaks from my throat, very brief.

lines.zh: 我把头垂下去，谁也没在看。
lines.en: I let my head droop, though no one is watching.
I pick up a block of earth.
A gap is left in the ground.

lines.zh: 拿起来看看，又放回原处。
lines.en: I lift it to look, then put it back where it was.

lines.zh: 手臂比我想要的高出了一截。
lines.en: My arm rises higher than I intended by a good stretch.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我的头跟着低。
lines.en: You step back half a pace and my head lowers after you.

lines.zh: 骨头在皮下错开，咔了一下。
lines.en: Bone shifts beneath the skin with a single click.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝叶，我都听见了。
lines.en: Every twig you snap, I hear.
You back to the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 指头穿过铁片，碰到里面的热。
lines.en: My fingers pass through the iron and touch the heat beneath.

lines.zh: 爪子压着你的胸口，地很硬。
lines.en: A claw pins your chest and the ground is hard beneath you.
A black split opens in the ground.
I slide back half a step.

lines.zh: 空地上多了一个站着的影子。
lines.en: A standing shadow appears in the clearing.
I take shape out of the smoke.

lines.zh: 这地方的空气干得发脆。
lines.en: The air here is so dry it feels brittle.

lines.zh: 林子那头有声音，我在听。
lines.en: There's a sound at the far side of the woods; I'm listening.
I tilt my head your way.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过草，落得很轻。
lines.en: One stride carries me over the grass, landing softly.

lines.zh: 我转过头，眼睛没有跟着动。
lines.en: I turn my head, though my eyes don't follow.
There's no door here, but I will.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，紫色变成黑的。
lines.en: Fire burns on me; the violet turns black.

lines.zh: 落下去的时候我的身体拉得很长。
lines.en: As I fall my body stretches long.

lines.zh: 水打湿了我，紫色散开了。
lines.en: Water soaks me; the violet comes apart.

lines.zh: 爆响把我的上半身吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my upper body.

lines.zh: 一根尖物穿过我，留下紫边。
lines.en: A point passes through, leaving violet edges.

lines.zh: 那道光绑住了我的关节。
我空得太久，快撑不住形。
lines.en: Empty too long; I can barely hold shape.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身的紫都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits; all my violet flares.

lines.zh: 这里空得像我来的地方。
lines.en: This void is like where I came from.
